gloss: to connect, to link, to tie together

examples.japanese: インターネットに{繋|つな}げる。
{点|てん}と{点|てん}を{繋|つな}げる。

notes:
{繋|つな}げる means to connect, link, or tie things together.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {繋|つな}がる (intransitive) - to be connected

COMMON PATTERNS:
- インターネットに{繋|つな}げる: to connect to the internet
- WiFiに{繋|つな}げる: to connect to WiFi
- {手|て}を{繋|つな}げる: to join hands
- {点|てん}と{点|てん}を{繋|つな}げる: to connect the dots
- {次|つぎ}の{世代|せだい}に{繋|つな}げる: to pass on to the next generation

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {命|いのち}を{繋|つな}げる: to sustain life
- {関係|かんけい}を{繋|つな}げる: to maintain a relationship
- {話|はなし}を{繋|つな}げる: to continue/extend a conversation

NOTE:
The kanji {繋|つな} can also be written as {繫|つな} (variant form).
